verdict.rationale: Luma documents an agent-readable API surface: llms.txt is live, every docs page has a .md version, there is a generation endpoint with Python/JS/TS SDKs, and credit-based pricing is listed per model (e.g., 20 credits for a 5s 360p draft). That supports submitting a prompt and estimating cost from published tables. Nothing in the pack shows how an agent would poll job status, retrieve the finished asset URL, or read the actual cost of a specific generation, and no OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: documented job status/polling or callback mechanism, documented asset retrieval/download step, per-job cost or credit-usage reporting in API responses, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end agent run.
